verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor documentation asserting an open license or independent, foundation-based governance model for Terraform (e.g., no mention of license terms, governance board, or contributor protections). The only relevant signals are single-tier community remarks about a CLA requirement and a past removal of a feature from the OSS build, which raise concern but are not corroborated by any docs/GitHub-tier claim to actually dispute — so this falls short of the 'disputed' bar (needs two tiers) and there is no positive evidence supporting 'full' or 'partial'. missing for 10: any first-party statement on license type/terms, evidence of open governance structure (foundation, RFC process, contributor rights), and independent confirmation that license cannot be unilaterally changed.
